dog.description_text:
Meet Fendi Fig, a couch potato who spends most of her time relaxing in the living room. While she takes some time to warm up to new people, she does well with a patient, low-pressure approach. She knows "sit" and "down," and she is highly treat-motivated.

Fendi is currently recovering from a wound on her face and is uncomfortable with certain handling, so her new family will need to give her space and respect her boundaries. She is fearful of grooming and does not allow bathing, brushing, or nail trimming right now. Fendi would be best suited for a calm, low-activity home looking for a quiet companion.
dog.name: Fendi Fig
